data.body:
[P2] Set the termination flag before invoking shutdown callbacks

`terminate()` invokes `setCheckpointTerminating` before setting `isTerminated`. The callback installed by `withDurableExecution` disables checkpoints and synchronously calls `terminated.abort()`. An abort listener that starts a step or child context therefore reads `false` here and passes the new guard, even though its checkpoints are already being dropped. Its function can still perform the unrecorded work this change intends to prevent. Move the flag assignment before the callback and add a regression test that starts an operation synchronously from an abort listener.
